description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the 'ModifyFeatureProperties' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages updating or creating feature properties on a 'Thing' entity, including size validation, event generation, and entity tagging.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the modification of feature properties on a 'Thing' entity, including validation, event creation, and tagging.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method to apply the modify feature properties command, performing size validation and feature extraction.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts a specific feature from a 'Thing' based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify existing feature properties or create new ones, returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating feature properties have been modified.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating new feature properties have been created.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' state for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the entity tag for the new 'Thing' state after modification.
